items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: And I loved Carmen Lombardo singing.

ctx.x: ...but when I was a kid, though, you know, before I ever heard Teddy Wilson play the piano, I was a Lombardo freak. I loved him. And I loved Carmen Lombardo singing. I loved Liebert. I loved everybody. I knew everybody's name. I was their number-one fan!
